insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Plan-dependent (Base Sum Insured options shown: 5/7.5/10/15/20/25/50/75/100/200 Lakhs depending on plan)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actual cost unless your Policy Schedule states otherwise, so you generally avoid limits or deductions based on room type.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: An additional sum insured buffer activates once your base sum insured is fully used, providing extra financial protection.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.reference: Section B.2.6 (Automatic Restore Benefit), point vi, page 18
great.explanation: Sum insured restoration can be used for the same illness within the policy year, allowing multiple claims for recurring conditions.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
great.explanation: Follow-up medical expenses are covered for up to 180 days after hospital discharge, ensuring extended care.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.reference: Section B.2.4 (Plus Benefit), point c, page 16
great.explanation: No claim bonus or renewal benefit does not reset to zero after a claim, helping maintain your benefits even if you claim.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Insured Person for the Non-Medical Expenses listed under Annexure B to this Policy incurred in relation to a claim admissible under Section B-1 (Base Coverage)
great.explanation: If the Protect Benefit is included, many consumables like gloves and masks are covered, reducing your out-of-pocket expenses.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months, which is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section C.1.b (Specified Disease/Procedure waiting period), page 28
good.explanation: Specific illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period before coverage begins, which is typical.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents, which is a common initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered, providing good pre-hospital care.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred by the Insured Person during the Policy Year towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care
good.explanation: Emergency air ambulance transport is covered if you have opted for this benefit, subject to policy limits.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Year on Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Treatment at home under defined conditions is covered, which helps when hospital admission is not possible.

good.name: Home Health Care
good.quote: This Cover is not available on reimbursement basis.
good.explanation: Home healthcare is covered but only through cashless service, so you cannot claim reimbursement for it.

good.name: Deductible
good.quote: The Insured Person shall bear an amount equal to the Aggregate Deductible specified on Policy Schedule once in a Policy Year post which coverage shall commence under this policy
good.explanation: You pay a specified deductible amount once per policy year before the insurer starts paying, which can lower your premium.

bad.name: Consumables Exclusion
bad.quote: Non-Medical expenses such as food charges (other than patients diet provided by hospital), laundry charges, attendant charges... Full list of Non-Medical Expenses is attached as ANNEXURE B
bad.reference: Section C.3.k (Specific Exclusions) & Annexure B, pages 32 and 49-50
bad.explanation: If the Protect Benefit is not included, many consumables and non-medical items are excluded, increasing your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-pay but does not clearly state if or how much co-pay applies by default; check your Policy Schedule for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
